rules: One colour, one meaning: every colour in the paper's figures, the Hugging Face cards, the site and the logo comes from this file.
Hue marks a method. NeCast's variants, parts and inputs use NeCast's purple at five lightness steps; another method's variant is tint() of that method's colour.
Truth, text, axes and anything that belongs to no method are ink and the grey scale.

Allowed derivations: tint() (lighten in HLS) of a method colour for a variant of that method (0.55 for 'without errors', 0.35 for other settings), and transparency of a colour here for bands and regions. Text in a colour too light to read takes the next darker step of its family (necast_light to necast_mid, grey_400 and grey_500 to grey_600, mutation to mutation_dark, smcpp and its 0.35 tint to smcpp_dark, another method's 0.35 tint to the method colour). Nothing else.
Continents are a separate, directly labelled encoding used only in population figures.
Scenario families are told apart by point shape or by panel, never by colour.

necast_deep.meaning: true maps (the oracle condition); the site encoder; accent text on pale purple

necast.meaning: NeCast: its curves, points and labels; the network (fusion, network inference); both maps; homozygous derived genotype; 'NeCast better'; site accent; logo

necast_mid.meaning: the recombination map: its traces and the recombination-map-only condition; summary statistics

necast_light.meaning: tint(necast): NeCast without errors or on simulated windows; PSMC+ posterior; heterozygous genotype

necast_pale.meaning: fills behind NeCast (the fusion box); site accent background

smcpp_dark.meaning: labels and text in SMC++'s colour (the green is too light for text)

mutation.meaning: the mutation map: its traces and the mutation-map-only condition

mutation_dark.meaning: labels and text in the mutation map's colour (the tan is too light for text)

false_variant.meaning: false variants (sequencing errors); used for nothing else

grey_700.meaning: axes and ticks; 'NeCast worse'; the end of a diverging scale opposite NeCast

grey_600.meaning: points without a method, annotations, centromeres; label text for grey points

grey_500.meaning: muted data: training curves, the oracle point, second example curves

grey_400.meaning: no map; a tie; deme outlines

grey_300.meaning: a tie that depends on the metric; connectors; outlines of missing cells

grey_200.meaning: card borders; the small source deme; the rate-level step behind a bar (Extended Data Fig. 4a)

grey_150.meaning: background curves; chromosome bars; deme fills

grey_50.meaning: card fills; the midpoint of a diverging scale

continents.note: Population figures only (Fig. 4e, Fig. 6, the 1000 Genomes card). hcl(h, c = 60, l = 50); populations within a group are an HCL ramp of the group's hue.

dark_ui.note: Dark theme of the site only, chosen for contrast on the dark background.
